verdict.rationale: Workable ships AI features, such as AI candidate recommendations and the Workable Agent, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The API claim of 'full control over your data' concerns programmatic data access, not training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
